The Wellspring
Modular courtyard practice kit

Original editable raster modules. Terrain, architecture, props and ambient clips are independent. This viewer is not a game build.

Standalone review candidate — not production approved. Shared visual_language_v1.json, authoritative checkout and checkpoint 286bd8f were unavailable. The palette is provisional. Nothing here creates collision, navigation, gameplay or automatic fading.

Every pictured part comes from its actual export. The full module grid includes all masks and overlays.

Equal-material edge profiles are tested at full resolution, including corners. Between different materials, dark rims are intentional.

Only a visual layout example. The neutral 58/68/76px bars are scale rulers, not characters. Layer PNGs and the demonstration-only placement JSON are in the folder.

GIF is sampled at 10fps. Individual module playback uses exact manifest ticks. Animation is local and optional, never a uniform moving texture pass.

Original source / CC0 to the extent waivable. No external images, requests, fonts or libraries are loaded by this file. Export PNGs contain no labels. Footprints are descriptive only.
